en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large domed stone building in a city square, with arched windows and a cross-topped finial on the dome. The architecture is clearly Ottoman but the cross suggests later Christian use. In front of the building is a busy street or square filled with 1950s–1960s European cars, and a row of multi‑storey historic buildings lines the right side of the scene.
